title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
statement: Evaluate the arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation. Tokens are integers or the operators +, -, *, and /. Division truncates toward zero. Return the integer result.
hints: A number is pushed. An operator pops two numbers, applies itself, and pushes the result.
The right operand is the first value popped.
Python's int() truncation toward zero differs from floor division for negatives. Use integer division that truncates toward zero.

approaches.name: Recursive descent on a reversed token list
approaches.explanation: Possible, but the stack is the natural machine for RPN.

editorial: RPN is the postfix form a stack machine evaluates directly. Pop b, pop a, push a op b. For division, truncating toward zero is int(a / b) in Python 3, not a // b, because floor division goes away from zero for negatives.
